rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: ISE MCP Server provides a bridge between AI assistants and Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) REST APIs, enabling dynamic discovery and retrieval of network security data. The server exposes ISE resources as structured JSON-RPC tools, allowing users to query endpoints, identity groups, authorization profiles, and other security configurations without direct API interaction. Built with Python and containerized for easy deployment, it features environment-driven configuration and comprehensive logging. This implementation is particularly valuable for network administrators who need to monitor and analyze their Cisco ISE deployments through AI assistants without navigating complex REST APIs.
